identity.insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
identity.renewal_terms: Lifelong guaranteed renewal, no claim loading.
identity.portability_conditions: Portability allowed as per IRDAI master circular.
identity.geographic_availability: Pan-India (Tier-1, Tier-2, Tier-3 with no zone penalties)

coverage.inpatient_hospitalization: Covered up to 100% of Sum Insured without room sub-limits.
coverage.domiciliary_hospitalization: Covered up to base Sum Insured.
coverage.ayush_treatment: Covered up to Sum Insured in government recognized institutions.
coverage.ambulance_cover: Road ambulance covered up to actuals; Air ambulance up to ₹5 Lakh.
coverage.organ_donor_expenses: Covered up to Sum Insured for harvesting costs.
coverage.modern_treatments: Covered up to Sum Insured for modern treatments without capping.
coverage.maternity_cover: Not covered in base Optima Secure plan.
coverage.opd_dental_vision: Emergency dental/ophthalmic care due to accident covered.
coverage.restoration_benefit: 100% restore benefit automatically kicks in immediately upon first claim.
coverage.cumulative_bonus: Plus Benefit: Doubles your base cover by 50% in year 1 and 50% in year 2 regardless of claims.
coverage.wellness_benefits: Preventive health check-up every renewal year irrespective of claim status.

restrictions.room_rent_capping: No Room Rent Capping (Any room category including Single Private AC Room or Deluxe). Zero proportionate deduction.
restrictions.pre_authorization_rules: Pre-authorization required 48h prior for planned, 24h for emergency.
restrictions.medical_necessity_clause: Standard IRDAI medical necessity clause applies.
restrictions.non_payable_items: Protect Benefit included by default: 100% coverage for consumables, gloves, masks, and non-medical items.

premium.pricing_factors: Age of oldest insured, family structure, sum insured.
premium.tax_benefits: Section 80D income tax exemption up to ₹25,000 / ₹50,000.
premium.medical_underwriting: Pre-policy medical examination determined by age and declared history.
premium.cancellation_refund_terms: Full refund within 15 days; pro-rata short period cancellation scale thereafter.

claims.cashless_claim_procedure: Present HDFC ERGO health e-card at hospital insurance desk -> cashless approval within 1 hour.
claims.reimbursement_claim_procedure: Intimate via HDFC ERGO Here App -> submit documents online -> settled within 7 days.
